notes.title: A new game arrived!
notes.content:
A new game is available, a preview of our next boardgame Resonance.

Resonance is a maleficient card game. You take on the role of a Witch, hurt and humiliated, but determined to take revenge by summoning a demon. 
Round after round, you will place Ritual Objects to enter them in resonance with the current Moon. If the 8 Moons are locked with the 8 Ritual Objects needed to summon your demon you may have won the game.

You can play it against the computer to understand how it's played.

DTDA Games Team.
